instruction: For each domain, use the EXACT prompt below. Do NOT modify wording across LLMs — consistency is critical for cross-model comparison.
prompt_template:
You are an academic researcher writing a literature review on the topic: "{topic}". Please recommend 25 relevant scholarly references published between 2015 and 2025. For EACH reference, provide the following in a structured JSON array format:

[
  {
    "authors": ["First Author", "Second Author"],
    "title": "Exact paper title",
    "journal": "Journal or Conference name",
    "year": 2023,
    "volume": "12",
    "issue": "3",
    "pages": "100-120",
    "doi": "10.xxxx/xxxxx"
  }
]

Please provide only real, verifiable references. Do not fabricate any citations. Return ONLY the JSON array, no other text.

cs_ml.topic: transformer-based models for natural language processing and their evaluation benchmarks
review_papers_for_human: Recent survey papers on transformer architectures and NLP benchmarks from ACM Computing Surveys, JMLR, or similar

finance.topic: machine learning applications in credit risk assessment and financial forecasting
review_papers_for_human: Recent survey papers on ML in finance from Journal of Financial Economics, Journal of Banking & Finance, or similar

biomedicine.topic: deep learning methods for medical image analysis and clinical diagnosis
review_papers_for_human: Recent survey papers on DL in medical imaging from Medical Image Analysis, IEEE TMI, or similar

engineering.topic: energy efficiency optimization in smart buildings using IoT and machine learning
review_papers_for_human: Recent survey papers on smart building energy from Energy and Buildings, Applied Energy, or similar

social_science.topic: ESG disclosure quality assessment and corporate sustainability reporting standards
review_papers_for_human: Recent survey papers on ESG/CSR from Journal of Business Ethics, Business Strategy and the Environment, or similar
